# Kirian Luna — Complete Developer & Systems Engineer Profile

> Kirian Luna is a software engineer from Limón, Costa Rica (UTC-6), focused on building modern digital products that solve real problems and create meaningful value for users and businesses. He combines strong engineering principles with a thoughtful approach to design and user experience, developing solutions that are scalable, performant, intuitive, and built with purpose. He holds a degree in Systems Engineering from Universidad Latina de Costa Rica.

## 2. Technical Stack & Core Competencies
- **Frontend Architecture**: TypeScript, React 19, Next.js (App Router), Astro, TailwindCSS v4, HTML5, Web Audio API, Framer Motion, Responsive UX/UI.
- **Backend & Database Systems**: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, RESTful API design, JWT Authentication, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Audit Logging.
- **Tools & Infrastructure**: Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Vite, NPM, Web Performance Audit (Core Web Vitals, SXO, SEO, AEO).

---

## 3. Notable Projects & Case Studies

### LEBP Academic Management System
- **Associated Entity**: Universidad Latina de Costa Rica / Liceo Experimental Bilingüe Pococí (LEBP).
- **Architecture**: Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM.
- **Features**: Enterprise-grade academic administration platform. Manages student enrollment, real-time attendance tracking with automated email notifications, grade calculations, PDF/Excel report generation, JWT authentication with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and security audit logs.

### Puerto Limón Cultural Platform
- **Scope**: Digital platform preserving the cultural identity and Afro-Caribbean heritage of Limón, Costa Rica.
- **Features**: Interactive historical archives, photograph collection, custom map overlays, and location story points.

### Young Legends
- **Scope**: Modern web application built for an athletic and streetwear brand.
- **Features**: High-converting responsive landing pages, micro-animations, fast asset rendering.

### UMP Music Platform
- **Scope**: Interactive web music streaming and audio experience application.
- **Features**: Custom Web Audio API implementation, interactive playback controls, audio visualizer feedback.
